_note: Seed data for the rules engine. All rules editable in Settings. 'locked' rules require admin to change.

waste_defaults.note: Never apply waste automatically except the approved residential defaults. Do not use 10% on residential without explicit approval.

rules.rule: Use EagleView 'Siding' wall area only, excluding windows and doors. Never include masonry-classified wall area or masonry corner LF.
Deduct windows and doors only. Stone/stucco zone deductions are a GC decision, not a default deduction.
Default residential siding product: 8.25" HardiePlank unless specified.
House wrap: use the cheapest wrap on the applicable BTR sheet unless the spec requires otherwise.
rules.logic: min(unit_price per SF of coverage) among items tagged house_wrap on the sheet in use

rules.rule: Roof SF comes from the roof plan sheet, never floor plan area schedules.
Coil roofing nails: 1 box per 15 SQ.
Always include 1.25" plastic cap nails: 1 box per 15 SQ.
Starter strip on eaves AND rakes.
30-yr shingle default when brand unspecified: Malarkey Vista AR (02MLVIA3AB) or CertainTeed Landmark ClimateFlex (03CTLCF3WW). User must pick one.
Hip & ridge coverage for takeoff math: 25 LF per bundle.
EPDM cover board is always a standard line item, never optional.
Pre-secured EPDM systems must include pre-securement fasteners and plates.
Placeholder accessory ratios allowed only until EagleView is received; must be labeled PLACEHOLDER.
Nebraska Form 17 Purchasing Agent Appointment must be executed with owner before materials are purchased. Confirm before setting job tax-exempt in AccuLynx.
Pull bid tabs after opening and store as calibration data.
